current.text: He is Denver's backup center behind Nikola Jokic and comes off the bench.
He is the player to use if Jokic misses time, with possible lines around 15 points and 10 rebounds.
He is also listed in Denver's forward depth behind Aaron Gordon, and that depth is described as abysmal.
Denver has 43 games through March 28 and only 14 back-to-backs, one of the lowest counts in the league.

durable.text: His fantasy profile is points, rebounds and FG%, with very low assists, bad free throws and subpar blocks for a big man.
Steals are a clear weak spot, at about 0.4 per game, and he makes almost no threes.
Backup centers in Denver historically do not produce, even ones who looked fine elsewhere.

note: Yahoo and ESPN both value him at 0 USD and rank him 244 and 256, far outside the 144 players drafted, so do not bid on him at the auction. He is a waiver add when Jokic misses time, when he can give points, rebounds, a strong FG% (about 58% projected) and few turnovers, but expect no steals, threes or assists. Early in the season, check whether David Adelman also gives him minutes at power forward behind Aaron Gordon.
